lookup.headline: Check your credit readiness
lookup.sub: No login needed. Enter your member number, phone, or national ID.

score.title: See your score
score.body: A number from 0–100, plus why it is that — in plain language.

loan.title: Apply for a loan
loan.body: See what you qualify for, choose an amount, then confirm by SMS.

improve.title: Know what to do next
improve.body: Short steps that raise your score. Reporting does not change it today.

score.offline: Showing saved data, may be outdated.
score.climateStay: Stick to this for your zone this season

kali.title: Kali
kali.ready: Ask with your voice or type
kali.noMic: This browser can't listen. Type instead.
kali.micFail: Couldn't hear that. Try again, or type.

improve.title: Improve your score
improve.evidenceHelp: Add a photo or a voice note so an officer can check. This does not change your score today.
improve.noAudio: This phone couldn't record. Add a photo instead.
improve.needEvidence: Add a photo or a voice note first.
improve.notePlaceholder: A short note for the officer
improve.success: Reported. An officer will verify. Your score stays the same today.
improve.error: Could not send the report. Try again when you have signal.
improve.note: Reporting a step does not change your score. Points apply only after an officer verifies.

loan.title: Apply for a loan
loan.eligibleHint: This limit comes from your score. You can ask for this amount or less.
loan.capNote: You cannot request more than you qualify for.
loan.overCap: That's more than you qualify for. We set it to KES {{amount}}.

guide.1: We show what you qualify for from your current score.
guide.2: You choose how much you want — up to that limit.
guide.3: You say what the money is for.
guide.4: Submit the application. Then the co-op reviews the request.

loan.payFirst: Pay your current loan first. Then you can apply again.
loan.lockedBody: Walk through these steps when your score reaches the next tier. Nothing is submitted until then.
loan.submitHelp: This sends your application to the co-op. The amount is set from your score and cannot be typed in.
loan.pendingBody: Your application for KES {{amount}} is being reviewed.
loan.error: Couldn't submit right now. Try again.
loan.otpHelp: We'll text a code to this member's phone before the application is sent.
loan.deductionsHelp: When harvest is paid, part of it can go to your loan. The rest is sent to you.
loan.noDeductions: No deductions on this harvest yet.

repay.title: Pay back your loan
repay.remaining: KES {{amount}} will still be owed after this payment.
repay.method: Payment will be collected by M-Pesa. Status shows as Pending until it is confirmed.
repay.success: Payment prompt sent to your phone. It shows as Pending until LOOP confirms it.
repay.error: Couldn't send the repayment prompt. Try again.

payout.title: Harvest payout
payout.help: Ask the co-op to pay unpaid produce to your M-Pesa. Any loan balance is deducted first.
payout.error: Couldn't start a payout right now.

admin.title: Flagged accounts
admin.sub: Read-only. Detection runs on the core platform — this list only displays what it flagged.

errors.notFound: We couldn't find that number. Check it and try again.
errors.network: No connection. If you checked a score before, we will show the saved one.
errors.rateLimited: Too many lookups. Wait a moment and try again.
